datasets.title: Ethiopia Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Ethiopia Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/ethiopia_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2021 and spatially encoded as geographic features (GeoJSON/KML) representing areas classified into IPC phases (1-5) indicating severity of acute food insecurity. The dataset aggregates multiple monthly snapshots to provide temporal coverage of food insecurity conditions across Ethiopia.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity and geographic extent.
